Provider-native publication/link semantics, even when rights-valid and cross-provider-conformant, lack required R7-owner custody/delegation, closed-world exhaustiveness, target operation sets, recommendation/execution authority, non-success terminals, target-algebra rights, signed ratification, and independent semantic review.

positive_result: A prospectively frozen, rights-bounded, outcome-blind structured-metadata gateway reconstructs all 12,038 exact-rights relations in 11,602 families and assigns 11,976 of 11,991 unique notices to exactly one of three provider-native strata without case text or scientific gold. After exact interface normalization, PubMed and Europe PMC relation-type sets match for 11,988 of 11,991 notices. This establishes a reusable three-stratum metadata construction frame and high relation-layer conformance, not scientific-action validity.
